description: Quick overview: student counts, pending requests, next five lessons and unread chat totals.
Search student profiles by name, subject, level, contact, rate or active state. Passwords are excluded.
Get an admin-visible student profile, excluding the password.
Create a student with portal credentials, family chat and diagnostic readiness record.
Patch profile fields. Omitted fields, including active status, are preserved.
Remove portal access immediately and preserve history.
Retrieve the selected student portal username/password for sharing. Sensitive: never request for an entire roster.
Search and paginate private admin student notes.
Add a private student profile note.
Delete the specified private profile note.
Get the current active parent share link, if present.
Replace old parent links with a newly generated active link.
Revoke this student’s parent links.
Check the proposed Malaysia time against every non-canceled lesson. Creation/moving still rechecks atomically.
Compute Present/(Present+Absent), excluding canceled/unmarked lessons. Legacy Late counts as Present.
Search schedule/history, filter student/status and inclusive local dates. Status: scheduled/completed/canceled.
Get class details, report and tutor notes. Student-private notes are excluded.
Schedule one lesson. Malaysia local time; duration is 60,90 or120 minutes; global tutor overlap is checked.
Move/resize a scheduled lesson without making a replacement. Malaysia date/time.
Patch class details/status using the existing class validations.
Mark Present or Absent using normal billing/report side effects.
Advance cancel a class; optional replacement time. Original history/trial classification are preserved.
Create the linked replacement for a scheduled or advance-canceled class.
Save/patch topics, homework, feedback and rating. Omitted fields are preserved; normal automatic attendance behavior applies.
Search class reports, optionally scoped to one student and date range.
Save formatted private teacher notes for a lesson.
Search private teacher meeting notes by student, lesson date or content.
List recurring series and generation state.
Create a finite series; default end is December31 of the start year. day_of_week uses0Sunday..6Saturday.
Extend the selected series through the given allowed end date.
Stop future scheduled lessons while keeping series/history.
List/filter invoice documents including private drafts.
Get invoice lines, amounts, status and printable browser link. Does not change payment status.
Prepare the invoice WhatsApp text/link for manual sharing. This does not send a message or change invoice status.
Generate draft invoice(s) from attended unclaimed lessons, split by billing month.
Set Draft/Sent/Paid/Overdue/Cancelled using existing bookkeeping and notifications.
Cancel invoice while preserving financial history.
Billing-month revenue totals and time series; optional student/status and inclusive date range.
Export formula-safe student/class/invoice CSV; browser print/save-PDF uses the invoice link.
Search stream/classwork by student, title, content, type or topic.
Get post, attachments, current submission and retained attempt/grade history for its owning student.
List classroom topics and ordering.
Create a classroom topic.
Rename an existing owned topic.
Remove the topic organization while preserving posts/work.
Post material, assignment or announcement with formatted content, links and attachments.
Patch post content/rubric/topic. Existing files remain unless their IDs are explicitly removed; new attachments are appended.
Delete a post and its dependent classroom data.
Move to a topic/ungrouped and/or before another post. Null before_post_id means end.
Attach a managed file or safe external learning link to a post.
Remove/replace a post attachment reference.
Grade ONLY the current attempt; expected_version is required to reject stale forms.
Read classroom discussion, including author and edit/delete history state.
Create or edit your tutor comment. Formatted content and links use the same sanitizer.
Delete a classroom comment using admin permissions.
Review pending/past student or parent requests with original/replacement details.
Approve a proposed or your own future Malaysia date/time; existing overlap/trial/history rules apply.
Reject a pending request and send the tutor explanation.
Read admin notification inbox and full unread count.
Mark one admin notification read.
Mark the admin inbox read.
List family chats and unread counts.
Read a family chat, with pagination or refreshed message IDs.
Send a tutor message with formatted content, reply or attachments. Stable client_id prevents duplicates.
Edit your tutor message.
Delete a family chat message using existing admin rules.
Mark family chat messages read up to the selected message.
Review all students’ diagnostic readiness states.
Read selected student answers, state, revision and report.
Open the one-time diagnostic when ready.
Lock diagnostic results; revision must match.
Import a diagnostic question bank; existing template versions are immutable.
Read personal or lesson board with revision. board_id is personal or class-N.
Save board scene using expected revision; returns conflict/current snapshot on stale writes. Maximum scene size is1MiB.
Get business/currency/payment details and QR. Storage secrets/session records are excluded.
Patch the business details shown on invoices and shared pages.
Upload a payment QR image from base64 (maximum500KB).
Remove the invoice QR image without changing payments.
Check whether the Drive upload connector is configured.
Generate the Drive connector deployment script. Sensitive: it includes its secret; keep private.
Upload a small supported file (up to2MiB) from base64; for larger files use upload_begin/chunk/finish without a total file cap.
Start an uncapped resumable upload; send returned ticket with bounded chunks, then finish.
Upload up to2MiB of file bytes (base64). Use returned nextOffset; replay identical ranges safely. A bytes */TOTAL range probes progress.
Finish the same upload ticket and register the managed file; use returned fileUrl in posts/messages.
List recent recoverable uploads from the Drive connector.
Recover/register an uploaded Drive file ID for attachment use.
Read a managed file in bounded chunks for download/inspection. No arbitrary remote URL fetching.
Inspect a previous write request by its request_id before retrying an uncertain result.
